per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond to user interactions within approximately five seconds for small transitions to ensure a snappy feel and prevent user impatience.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be available during all working hours for reps and external users, with planned maintenance only during early morning hours.
The system should support up to 350 concurrent active users during peak times without performance degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should integrate with existing authoritative data sources for transactions, cardmember details, and account adjustments to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should implement role-based and data segregation permissions to ensure that users can only access and modify data they are authorized to.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes System must prevent users from accessing any dispute cases that do not belong to their cardholder base.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should log all user actions, including who performed the action, what was done, and when it was done, to ensure auditability and compliance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'
